page.title: Exports
page.description: Export your schedule in different formats

files.title: PDF, Excel, CSV
files.description: PDF, Excel and CSV exports are available directly from the schedule, using the “Export” button in the toolbar.

ical.title: iCal
ical.description: iCal feed (.ics) to subscribe from Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar. The link is personal and updates automatically with the tasks assigned to you.
ical.help: Regenerating the token invalidates the previous link. Deleting the token disables the iCal feed completely.
